dataSource.title: Data Source
dataSource.urlInvalid: Enter an http(s) URL without a username, password or #fragment.
dataSource.refetchDaysHint: Recent days fetched again on every run. 0 or more.

schedule.enabledHint: Recalculates and publishes this brand's results every day. Manual runs work either way.
schedule.runTimeHint: Local time of day in the selected time zone. Schedule it after the previous day's orders have been sent.
schedule.timeZoneHint: Sets the run time and which day counts as yesterday for the order windows.
schedule.outletWindowDaysHint: Days of orders used per outlet, ending yesterday. 1 to 366.
schedule.customerWindowDaysHint: Days of orders used for customer favourites, ending yesterday. 1 to 366.
schedule.affinityWindowDaysHint: Days of orders used for items often bought together, ending yesterday. 1 to 366.

channels.description: Each ordering app is a channel: TQR (table QR), SOK (kiosk) and POS. Every API key serves one channel, and requests are recorded by channel.
channels.defaultsHint: Channels are switched off for new brands. API keys can only be created for an active channel.
channels.name: Name
channels.deactivateConfirmDescription: Within a minute, requests made with this channel's API keys are rejected until it is switched on again. Existing keys are kept.

outletItemScoresConfig.title: Popular Items Calculation
outletItemScoresConfig.currentHint: Saving creates a new version; past runs keep the version they used.
outletItemScoresConfig.halfLifeDaysHint: An order this many days old counts half as much as a new one.
outletItemScoresConfig.topNHint: How many top items are kept for each daypart.
outletItemScoresConfig.daypartsHint: Outlet local time. A daypart that ends before it starts runs past midnight.
outletItemScoresConfig.wholeDay: No dayparts: the whole day is ranked as one list.

issues.reservedName: The name {{name}} is reserved for the whole day.
issues.sameStartEnd: {{name}} must start and end at different times.

history.title: Version History
history.restoreConfirmDescription: This creates a new version with these settings and makes it the current one.

customerItemScoresConfig.title: Customer Items Calculation
customerItemScoresConfig.currentHint: Saving creates a new version; past runs keep the version they used.
customerItemScoresConfig.halfLifeDaysHint: An order this many days old counts half as much as a new one.
customerItemScoresConfig.topNHint: How many top items are kept for each customer in each daypart.
customerItemScoresConfig.maxRecentOrdersHint: Only the customer's latest orders in each daypart are scored. Older orders in the window are ignored.

history.title: Version History
history.restoreConfirmDescription: This creates a new version with these settings and makes it the current one.

itemAffinityConfig.title: Item Affinity Calculation
itemAffinityConfig.currentHint: Saving creates a new version; past runs keep the version they used.
itemAffinityConfig.topNHint: How many partner items are kept for each item.
itemAffinityConfig.minPairOrdersHint: Two items must share at least this many orders. Raise it to drop rare pairs.
itemAffinityConfig.maxOrderItemsHint: Larger orders are left out of the calculation, so big group bills don't create false pairs.

history.title: Version History
history.restoreConfirmDescription: This creates a new version with these settings and makes it the current one.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The brand and all its outlets are removed from every list, and its API keys stop working. Their stored data is kept.
